unspecified.behavior: A mouse click on a control-bar button followed by a keyboard shortcut press may make the focused button match :focus-visible and pin the bar visible again.

scores.reason: Triggered by clicking a bar button and then using Space/Arrow/M shortcuts while watching; the user sees the bar stay over the video until they click elsewhere.

When the viewer clicks a bar button such as Play and then uses a keyboard shortcut (arrows to seek, M, Space), the focused button can turn :focus-visible and the bar stays on screen over playback until focus moves elsewhere.

counted.reason: When the viewer clicks a bar button such as Play and then uses a keyboard shortcut (arrows to seek, M, Space), the focused button can turn :focus-visible and the bar stays on screen over playback until focus moves elsewhere.

unspecified.behavior: While the bar is hidden by the idle timer, mouse-focused controls inside it no longer get pointer-events back, so the faded bar cannot be clicked through until the timer shows it again (previously focus-within restored pointer-events whenever a clicked control kept focus).

scores.reason: Triggered by idling after a click; moving the mouse re-shows the bar, so the user sees no practical difference.
Once the idle timer has faded the bar, it ignores clicks even when a clicked control still has focus; in practice moving the mouse onto the frame re-shows it first, so the user rarely notices.

counted.reason: Triggered by idling after a click; moving the mouse re-shows the bar, so the user sees no practical difference.
